integrity: The theorem is proved from the printed PNE1 equations and a compact-invariant-measure argument; the source's numerical simulations are context only and are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is conditional on compact recurrence and does not prove existence, uniqueness, ergodicity, mixing, or chaos.
The strict two-sided conclusion requires \(c\ne0\); at \(c=0\) the equilibrium line invalidates it.
No quantitative lower bound is obtained for residence time, invariant mass, or excursion depth in either \(z\)-half-space.
The earliest exact public date located is 2014-05-28; no earlier public preprint date was found in the checked searches.
title: Strict two-sided height recurrence in the Pham no-equilibrium PNE1 flow
